objective: Main line 1 of the 2026-10-01 research program: test whether a multi-signal, risk-controlled, cost-aware US equity book (U3000; dollar- and beta-neutral F1 with T-bills; slow value, quality, investment/issuance, momentum, low-risk, earnings, insider, short-information and seasonality themes; cvxpy optimizer over an own Barra-lite risk model, NBBO-calibrated costs and an easy-to-borrow proxy) earns a net Sharpe that passes K1 or K2 together with the placebo, beta, solver and 2x-cost conditions in both the stress and anchor windows.
target_regime_and_horizon: US equities U3000 (adv_rank <= 3000, price >= $5, non-fund, 252 sessions of history), weekly rebalancing with 5 offsets judged at the median, 21-session residual-return forecasts. All regimes from 2017-10-02: stress 2017-10-02..2023-08-31 and anchor 2024-01-08..2026-09-17 judged separately, gap 2023-09..2023-12 reported alone, forward from 2026-09-18.
existing_solution_comparison: Professional systematic long/short equity funds net Sharpe median 0.51 and 90th percentile 1.18 (AQR/HFR 1996-2023); JKMP Portfolio-ML net 1.38 for a $10B large-cap investor; Chen-Velikov: single anomalies net about 4 bp/month post-2005, combinations about 20 bp. Off-the-shelf tooling is reused (cvxpy + Clarabel; skfolio only as a cross-check; JKMP's code is too heavy at about 75 GB, so a reduced version). No public record covers this universe, cost model and the 2024-26 window, so the run is needed. Our standalone long-only anomaly tests (263 directions, 3 passed) and the T-19 model books are the negative baseline; the Stage 0 hedged books (P1000 8-book combo anchor 0.58, stress -0.23) are contaminated diagnostics, not results.
remaining_evidence_gap: Whether the combination, with real risk control and modelled costs, survives on our free data (SEC fundamentals, Form 4 insider, FINRA short volume, short interest) in both windows; whether single-name shorts restricted to an easy-to-borrow proxy keep any of the Q2-pool edge; whether ML (M2/M3) adds over the equal-weight composite M0.
negative_experiments_checked: Registry check (263 directions): standalone refutations of earnings drift, insider clusters, net issuance, short volume, overnight persistence, intraday families and pure price-volume ranking (T-17/T-19) are readmitted only as book inputs. H-20260929-12, the only earlier hedged multi-factor attempt, died of a label/holding-return mismatch, fixed by the single return implementation (D2 unit test 4). The Stage 0 252-day beta hedge left realised beta 0.5-0.9, hence the risk model and the beta constraint. The Q2 strength came from shorting dilutive microcaps with borrow unmodelled, hence SE_t and borrow costs.
cost_and_execution_assumptions: Signal at close t, fill at the open of t+1 (daily-bar first print); half-spread from cost model v1 (Alpaca NBBO, open-window coefficients), square-root impact Y = 0.5 at E = $1M, fees 0.5 bp per side, borrow 25 bp a year on all short notional (100 bp a year in the 2x-cost check); F1 structure L = S <= 0.5E plus T-bills 1.0E, so no margin interest; shorts in whole shares, only SE_t names or hedge ETFs; fixed 10 and 20 bp per side reported for comparison only.
stop_condition: All 12 Stage 2 variants fail research_pass: book v1 is refuted, the infrastructure is kept and the next step is the signal library (text and other free sources), with no parameter tuning; if M0's residual IC in the anchor window also has NW t < 2, new signals come before any v2 contract. A forward shadow (only if a variant passes) stops after 63 sessions with Sharpe < 0 and below the placebo median.

cheapest_decisive_test.action: T-20261001-08: run M0 and M1 x A/B/C (6 variants x 5 weekly offsets) through backtest.run_book with the optimizer adapter at model cost; replay the cached target weights at 2x cost and at fixed 10/20 bp; evaluate K1, K2 (raw and cash-matched), realised beta (daily and Dimson), solver failures; run the 100-seed within-date permutation placebo only for variants that pass K1 or K2.
cheapest_decisive_test.pass_condition: Any variant passes (1) K1 or K2 and every condition of (2) at the median offset, as frozen in docs/equity-book-design.zh.md section 10 together with the stricter lead additions written in hypotheses.md before any Stage 2 output.
cheapest_decisive_test.falsification_condition: All six Stage-2a variants fail (1); after Stage 2b all twelve fail research_pass, so book v1 is refuted.
